dependency.notBuiltOn: row 5 — Intent & Question Clustering (FAILED): its clusters are not read, and a test fails the build if this module's import closure reaches row 5's clusterer, lexicon or reference, or row 6's modules that import them

rules.floor: a country says something about local phrasing only with at least 5 human country×query rows — the floor row 6 set for locality. Below it the country is UNKNOWN: never "no local difference", and UNKNOWN never defaults to anything (LAW-ABSENT-1)
rules.grouping: two wordings express the same goal only when ROW 3's discovered evidence links them — a SYNONYM or ABBREVIATION pair row 3 recorded on a shared landing page, or a VARIANT form (a plural, a one-letter spelling, punctuation) found by row 3's own rule and checked against row 3's counts — joined transitively. Nothing is grouped by hand, and row 5's clusters are not read
rules.absence: a wording not seen from a country is UNKNOWN for that country, never "not used there": Search Console withholds rare queries, and each country×query pair is ONE row (LAW-ABSENT-1)

reasoning.why: a query row carries the words a person typed and the country Search Console places them in — not why they typed them. Local PHRASING is researched here; local REASONING is not in the store

halfA.state: TESTED — by the country→URL census over src/ and bin/, within its stated limits

halfB.clause: without evidence of materially different useful content
halfB.why: whether the useful content differs by country needs the ANSWER at each country, and the store holds questions, not answers. A different question mix is not a different answer: row 6 measured that the question mix differs in all 10 countries with five or more rows, and that is NOT evidence for this half
halfB.unblockedBy: per-value answer evidence — for each country compared, the useful answer from a source that is not our own page (row 7 SUPPLY or row 2, both deferred) — which is the owner's pending decision. With it authorised and captured, this half is run; until then it is never PASS

row6.source: row 6 — runs/audit/row6-census-2026-09-14.txt, pinned by row 6's own test

estate.why: a country-like axis ALREADY multiplying the connected products' pages without evidence — in their pages, not in this engine's code, so no census of src/ and bin/ can see it

limits: every country×query pair is ONE row: a country's use of a wording is one observation, however many impressions it carries

the grouping inherits row 3's limits: a SYNONYM is interchangeable use in the same query frame for the same page, not proof of the same meaning (daily↔life among them), and transitive joins can chain wordings no single pair connects

row 3's relations are sparse, so a goal a person would recognise is NOT joined unless row 3's evidence joins it — "daily lifestyle" and "personal habits" stay apart from "daily habits" here, however alike they read
Search Console's country is where the searcher was, as Google reports it — not their nationality and not their language
local REASONING is not observable in query rows; only local PHRASING is researched

a row-3 ABBREVIATION pair joins two wordings only in the same frame; the grouping rule gained that constraint after its first run, when a pair sharing only a landing page joined "i don t have a cv" to "how to write a curriculum vitae with no experience"
row 3's VARIANT spelling rule is an edit distance of one, so in↔on is read as one word written two ways
